articles.title: Shaquille O'Neal addresses Fever's Kelsey Mitchell's remarks on Caitlin Clark, says to leverage the spotlight - Fox News
articles.description: Shaquille O'Neal advised Indiana Fever guard Kelsey Mitchell to remain in Caitlin Clark's orbit as the All-Star nears free agency in January.
articles.content:
Shaquille ONeal is no stranger to having a lot of eyeballs on him, both literally and figuratively. For Indiana Fever star Kelsey Mitchell, its been an adjustment.
